medical_underwriting.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
medical_underwriting.v: 'Guarantee Issue with no medical questions or exams.' Key features also state: 'You decide how to use the benefit funds - for medical and non-medical expenses'; 'Cost-effective premiums with convenient payroll deduction'; claims may be filed online or by post; 'You'll receive benefit funds to use however you wish.'

product_type.v: Business Workers of America membership built around a MEDICAL BILL REPRICER (MBR) plus a scheduled accident and sickness indemnity benefit. The Info page headline is 'MEDICAL BILL REPRICER'. Components: exceptional customer support coordinating benefits for members and providers; a $25/$50 pre-pay - 'Customers pay only $25 for Primary Care and $50 for Specialist, at time of service. No Limit to the number of visits'; PHCS PPO Network - 'All In-Network medical bills are repriced to the PHCS Network rate'; and Advocacy - 'MBR's support team will assist in lowering medical bills and help members access Financial Assistance'.

excluded_services.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
excluded_services.v: No benefits for loss caused directly or indirectly by: the six-month specified conditions above; any act of war or act related to war, or active service in the armed forces or military service for any country at war (with a pro-rata premium refund available on written request during suspension for military service); dental treatment or routine vision services unless due to injury and performed within 12 months of the covered accident, or due to congenital defect or birth anomaly of a covered newborn; intentionally self-inflicted injury or sickness; committing or attempting a felony; injury or sickness while engaging in an illegal occupation; cosmetic care except medically necessary reconstructive plastic surgery (defined as surgery to restore normal bodily function, to improve functional impairment from a congenital birth defect or anomaly, or breast reconstruction following mastectomy); intoxication or being under the influence of any narcotic unless taken as directed by a physician; experimental treatment, drugs or surgery except in connection with an APPROVED CANCER CLINICAL TRIAL; IMMUNIZATIONS; artificial insemination, in vitro or test tube fertilization, sterilization, tubal ligation or vasectomy and reversals; participation in any sport for pay or profit; serious mental illness without demonstrable organic disease if not applicable to the plan; alcoholism or drug addiction treatment if not applicable to the plan; services for which payment is not legally required, except Medicaid and certain VA and military facility care; participating in a riot, insurrection, rebellion, civil commotion, civil disobedience or unlawful assembly; participation in a contest of speed in power driven vehicles, parachuting or hang gliding; air travel except as a fare-paying passenger on a commercial airline on a regularly scheduled route; sex changes; and 'A DIAGNOSIS OR TREATMENT RECEIVED OUTSIDE THE UNITED STATES, OR ITS TERRITORIES, THAT CANNOT BE CONFIRMED BY A PHYSICIAN LICENSED AND PRACTICING IN THE UNITED STATES. The covered person, AT HIS OR HER OWN EXPENSE, is responsible for obtaining such confirmation.'

pre_existing.v: 'Pre-Existing Condition Period / Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion Period: Not applicable' as printed on the Info page.

addons.mbr.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
addons.mbr.v: MBR as described in this brochure: $25 pre-pay for Primary Care Office Visits, $25 PRE-PAY FOR URGENT CARE FACILITY VISITS, $50 pre-pay for Specialist Doctor Visits. 'Choose a network physician for maximum savings. To locate a PHCS network provider, call 888-371-7427 or visit www.MultiPlan.com.' Network reach: 'more than 5,500 hospitals, over 164,000 ancillary facilities, and over 1.3 million health care providers in the United States, including Puerto Rico. The network covers over 95% of the US population.' White Glove Advocacy finds low-cost providers in advance and negotiates remaining balances after discounts and insurance, 'sometimes even eliminate the remaining balance completely'. DISCLAIMER: 'while we strive to assist, we cannot guarantee the outcome of any claim or the amount of savings on any bill. A MAJORITY OF THE TIME, MBR REPRICES BILLS TO AMOUNTS EXCEEDING MEDICARE'S ALLOWABLE RATE, BUT MEDICAL PROVIDERS MAY STILL DECLINE TO HONOR THIS SERVICE.' MBR provider line 877-278-4668. Insert code MBR-062524-198.

addons.non_insurance.v: DIRECTLABS - up to 80% off typical lab costs, no doctor's appointment necessary, CLIA-certified labs, blood, urine, saliva, hair and fecal tests; order at directlabs.com/4members or 1-800-908-0000 with code R-CALSTAR. ALLHEART medical uniform and equipment discounts, code 1237310FS. Administrative address: PO Box 985, Camden TN 38320, 877-256-8001.

benefit.hospital_admission_conditions.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
benefit.hospital_admission_conditions.v: 'Hospital Admission Benefit - Payable ONLY ONCE PER PERIOD OF CONFINEMENT if a covered person is admitted and confined as an inpatient in a hospital due to an injury or covered sickness. NOT PAYABLE FOR OUTPATIENT TREATMENT, EMERGENCY ROOM TREATMENT OR A STAY OF LESS THAN 18 HOURS IN AN OBSERVATION UNIT.' 'Hospital Confinement Benefit - Must be confined as an inpatient... This benefit is NOT PAYABLE ON ANY DAY A HOSPITAL ADMISSION BENEFIT IS PAYABLE.' 'Intensive Care Unit Admission Benefit - Payable only once per period of confinement in an ICU.' 'Intensive Care Unit Benefit - If the plan is Non-HSA compatible, benefits will be paid beginning the first day of ICU confinement.' A hospital 'is not an institution, or part thereof, used as a place for rehabilitation, a place for rest or for the aged, a nursing or convalescent home, a long-term nursing unit or geriatrics ward or an extended care facility'.

benefit.pregnancy_and_dependents.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
benefit.pregnancy_and_dependents.v: 'Pregnancy Coverage: Included.' The exclusion list excludes 'pregnancy or childbirth, except complications of pregnancy, IF NOT APPLICABLE TO THE PLAN' and separately excludes 'PREGNANCY OF AN ELIGIBLE DEPENDENT CHILD' outright, and 'voluntary abortion except, with respect to you or your covered eligible dependent spouse: where you or your dependent spouse's life would be endangered if the fetus were carried to term or where medical complications have arisen from abortion'. Eligible dependent means a lawful spouse and/or a child (natural, adopted or step) under 26, plus any minor under the insured's charge placed for adoption, any child under 26 for whom medical support is ordered under Texas Family Code Section 14.061, and grandchildren who are federal income tax dependents.

termination.sec: membership package brochure / APL MedChoice Summary of Benefits
termination.v: Coverage ends on the earliest of: the date the policy terminates; the date the certificate terminates; the date the renewal premium became due once the grace period has ended if unpaid; the end of the policy period in which APL receives written request to terminate; the date a covered person no longer qualifies as an insured or eligible dependent; or death. 'APL may end coverage of any covered person who submits a fraudulent claim.'

terms.scanned_findings.v: TERMS panel, 11,133 characters. Targeted scan confirms it is the same BWA membership agreement served on the Paramount pages: FirstEnroll charges 'on behalf of Business Workers of America'; an Enrollment Fee described as the cost of the administrators assisting with the application for membership in the Association; 'contact customer service within 30 days for a full refund (enrollment fees are not refundable)'; client checkboxes including 'You attest that you are currently working' and an agreement to call (732) 876-9733 if no email arrives within 24 hours.
